April 8, 1937.                                      Morning Translation.

China Evening News and other local newspapers:-

THE REDUCTION OF WAGES OF SEAMEN ON S.S. "NINGZING"

The reduction of wages of seamen on the s.s.
"Ningzing" (甯靜) of the Ningpo Shaoshing S.N. Company
has met with opposition. Negotiations have been going
on for some time, but without success.

The vessel is now in Shanghai and the seamen
have issued a manifesto asking the public for assistance.

The entire body of the seamen of the China
Merchants Steam Navigation Company have expressed their
support of the seamen on the s.s. "Ningzing" and are
opposing the proposed cancellation by the Company of the
issue of double wages at the end of the year.

The crew of the shops belonging to the San Peh
( 三北 ), Hung An ( 鴻安 ) and Ning Shing ( 甯興 ) Companies
have issued a manifesto supporting the opposition raised
by the seamen of the s.s. "Ningzing" to a reduction in
their wages.

1937年4月8日。                                      晨间译件。

《中国晚报》及其他本地报纸：-

“甯靜”轮海员工资削减事件

宁波绍宁轮船公司（Ningpo Shaoshing S.N. Company）所属“甯靜”轮（S.S. "Ningzing"）海员的减薪遭遇反对。谈判已持续一段时间，但未获成功。

该船目前位于上海，海员们发表宣言，请求公众援助。

招商局轮船公司的全体海员表示支持“甯靜”轮海员，并反对该公司拟取消年底双薪的计划。

三北、鸿安和甯兴公司所属各店铺的船员发表宣言，支持“甯靜”轮海员反对减薪的抗争。

No. D

Ningpo Shaoshing S.N.Company - crew of s.s. "Ningzing" oppose pay cut

In connection with the recent reduction in the pay of the crew of the s.s. "Ningzing" of the Ningpo Shaoshing S.N.Company, 63 Kiangse Road (vide I.R.7/4/37), the seamen on the s.s. "Sing Ningshao" and the s.s. "Lou Ningshao" of the Company declared a strike in sympathy with the crew of the s.s. "Ningzing" in the afternoon of April 7. The strike, which delayed the departure of the two steamers for two hours, was called off as a result of mediation by Mr. Tu Yueh-sung.

At 6.30 p.m. April 7, the Chinese Marine Engineers' Association, the Marine Officers' Guild, the China Marine Radio Officers' Union and the China Navigators' Federation held a joint reception for newspaper men at the Tsin Loong Restaurant, Nanking and Yu Ya Ching Roads corner, when about 30 persons attended. During the function, the opposition to the reduction in pay of the s.s. "Ningzing" was explained and the support of the newspapers was solicited.

A meeting to settle the dispute between the crew of the s.s. "Ningzing" and the management of the Ningpo Shaoshing S.N. Company will be held at 9 a.m. April 8 in the Bureau of Shipping and Navigation, 53 Foochow Road.

Miscellaneous

Ningpo Fellow Countrymen's Association - new committee members assume office

Twenty-four committee members of the Ningpo Fellow Countrymen's Association, who were elected on April 1,1937, held a meeting in the office of the Association, 480 Yu Ya Ching Road, on the afternoon of April 7, when they formally assumed office, and elected a standing committee of seven members.

宁波绍宁轮船公司 - “甯靜”轮船员反对减薪

关于宁波绍宁轮船公司（地址：江西路63号，参见 I.R.7/4/37）所属“甯靜”轮船员近期减薪一事，该公司所属“新甯绍”轮（s.s. "Sing Ningshao"）和“楼甯绍”轮（s.s. "Lou Ningshao"）的海员于4月7日下午宣布罢工，以声援“甯靜”轮船员。此次罢工导致两艘轮船离港延误两小时，后经杜月笙先生调解，罢工得以取消。

4月7日下午6时30分，中国轮机工程师协会、高级船员公会、中国船舶无线电报员联合会和中国引水联合会于南京路与亚尔培路转角处的金龙酒家联合举行记者招待会，约有30人出席。活动期间，与会者说明了反对“甯靜”轮减薪的情况，并争取新闻界的支持。

定于4月8日上午9时，在福州路53号航政局举行会议，以解决“甯靜”轮船员与宁波绍宁轮船公司管理层之间的纠纷。

杂项

宁波同乡会 - 新委员就职

宁波同乡会于1937年4月1日选举产生的24名委员，于4月7日下午在亚尔培路480号该会办事处举行会议，正式就职，并选举产生由七人组成的常务委员会。

Tien Tsong Paper Mill (Chinese) - resumption of operations

In connection with the strike in the Tien Tseng
Paper Mill, No.313 North Fu Teng Road, Pootung, which
commenced on April 2 for the purpose of enforcing demands
for an increase of wages (vide I.R.3/4/37), 80 of the workers
resumed work unconditionally this morning, April 7. This
mill employs approximately 230 hands, and it is expected
that the remainder will soon resume work.

Ningpo Shaoshing S.N.Company - crew of s.s. "Ningzing"
oppose pay cut

In connection with recent reduction in pay of the crew
of the s.s. "Ningzing" of the Ningpo Shaoshing S.N.Company,
63 Kiangse Road, the Chung Hwa Seamen's Special Tangpu
was requested by the crew to take the matter up with the
management of the Ningpo Shaoshing S.N. Company.

On April 6, representatives of the seamen employed
on the steamers of the San Peh S.N. Company, the Hong Shing
S.N. Company and the seamen on other steamers of the Ningpo
Shaoshing S.N.Co. called at the Chinese Marine Engineers'
Association, 253 Lin Kuo Road, Nantao, and requested
mediation in the dispute. The delegates stated that
should the management of the Ningpo Shaoshing S.N.Co.
persist in their decision to reduce the pay, a strike of
the seamen of the three companies would be enforced.

天丰造纸厂（华资）- 恢复运营

关于浦东富通北路313号天丰造纸厂为要求增加工资而于4月2日开始罢工一事（参见 I.R.3/4/37），该厂工人中有80人于今晨（4月7日）无条件复工。该厂雇佣工人约230名，预计其余人员也将很快复工。

宁波绍宁轮船公司 - “甯靜”轮船员反对减薪

关于宁波绍宁轮船公司（地址：江西路63号）所属“甯靜”轮船员近期减薪一事，船员请求中华海员特别党部就此事项与宁波绍宁轮船公司管理层进行交涉。

4月6日，三北轮船公司、鸿兴轮船公司所属轮船的海员代表，以及宁波绍宁轮船公司其他轮船的海员，前往南市林国路263号中国轮机工程师协会，请求调解此纠纷。代表们声明，如果宁波绍宁轮船公司管理层坚持减薪决定，三家公司的海员将实行罢工。

（批注：220.6）

S.1 Special Branch Station,

Date March 17 19 37.

Subject Alleged labour trouble among employees in the employ of the Ningpo-Shao-
shing Steam Navigation Co., (Chinese), 63 Kiangse Road.

Made by D.S.I. Shih Ssu-chien    Forwarded by J. Boyne D.S.I.

With reference to the remarks of the D.C. (Special
Branch) on the attached report, further enquiries show that the
Ningpo-Shaoshing Steam Navigation Company owns altogether three
ships, namely the s.s. Ning-shao sailing between Yangtze River
Ports; the s.s. Sing Ning-shao sailing between Shanghai and
Ningpo; and the s.s. Ning Zing, which was leased for a term of
six months to the Zung Chong Shipping Company, sailing between
Tsingtao and Shanghai. The first named two ships, when arriving
at Shanghai, will berth at the Ning-shao Wharf, the Company owned
property at Nantao Bund, whilst the s.s. Ning Zing will berth
at the Hung Sheng Wharf, Pootung. These vessels have never
berthed at Settlement wharves.

The s.s. Ning Zing is at present in Shanghai moored at
the Hung Sheng Wharf, Pootung. The staff of the ship, when
interviewed by the Manager of the Zung Chong Shipping Company,
stated that their dissatisfaction was not caused by the cut in
pay by the Zung Chong Shipping Company, but arose when they learned
that the management of the Ningpo-Shaoshing Steam Navigation Co.
had decided to pay them in accordance with the reduced scale of
pay when the ship returned under the control of them. They
presented a protest to the management against this decision, but
had not yet received a favourable reply.

Judging from the circumstances, it appears, however,
that no strike of the employees of this ship is imminent.

S.1 特务站，

日期 1937年3月17日。

主题 据称宁波绍宁轮船公司（华资，地址：江西路63号）雇员中的劳资纠纷。

呈报人 警探长 施思坚 (Shih Ssu-chien)    转呈人 J. Boyne 警探长

参照附函中特务处副巡官的评语，进一步调查显示，宁波绍宁轮船公司共拥有三艘船只，即航行于长江各港口间的“甯绍”轮；航行于上海与宁波间的“新甯绍”轮；以及租给中和轮船公司（Zung Chong Shipping Company）为期六个月、航行于青岛与上海间的“甯靜”轮。前两艘船抵达上海时，将停靠于该公司位于南市外滩所有的甯绍码头，而“甯靜”轮则停靠于浦东鸿升码头。这些船只从未停靠在租界码头。

“甯靜”轮目前停泊于浦东鸿升码头。中和轮船公司经理在与该船职员面谈时，职员表示他们的不满并非由中和轮船公司减薪引起，而是当他们得知宁波绍宁轮船公司管理层决定在船只收回由其控制后，按降低后的薪资标准支付工资时产生的。他们已向管理层对此决定提出抗议，但尚未收到满意答复。

然而，从情况来看，该船雇员似乎不太可能 imminent（即将）发生罢工。

the above company was interviewed on March 12, and stated that
the item published in the China Press was unfounded. He admitted,
however, that although the above information was not true, unrest
was nevertheless afoot among the crew of the s.s. "Ning Zing",
which his Company had leased to the Zung Chong Shipping Co.,
110 Szechuen Road on February 20, 1937. As a result of the
charter, a reduction in pay was made by the latter Company and
this aroused general dissatisfaction among the employees. His
Company, Mr. Tsoh stated, did not assume the responsibility for
the reduction.

Further enquiries show that on March 3, 1937, the
Ningpo-Shaoshing Steam Navigation Company was in receipt of a
letter from the China Marine Engineer Association, 263 Ming Kuo
Road, Nantao, requesting the management to withdraw its decision
to reduce the wages of the marine engineers employed on the s.s.
Ning Zing. This letter was ignored by the management for the
reason as stated above.

by both parties, and he was surprised that the employees should
now take such a step. This company did not receive any complaint

参照附上的报纸文章，该文称由于据称减薪，江西路63号宁波绍宁轮船公司雇用的船员中潜伏着劳资纠纷。3月12日约谈了该公司一名曹先生 (Mr. Tsoh)，他表示《字林西报》刊登的消息毫无根据。然而他承认，虽然上述信息不实，但其公司于1937年2月20日租给四川路110号中和轮船公司的“甯靜”轮船员中确实存在不安情绪。由于租赁关系，后者公司降低了工资，这引起了雇员的普遍不满。曹先生表示，其公司不承担减薪的责任。

THE CHINA PRESS, THURSDAY, MARCH 11, 1937

Shanghai May Have Own
Ship Labor Clash Soon
* * * * * * * * * *
N.-S. CREWS RESTIVE
* * * * * * * * * *
Higher Wages Demanded

Labor trouble which may lead to a tie-up of the ships of the Ningpo-Shaoshing Steam Navigation Company was yesterday brewing among the crews employed by the firm.
The dispute, now being mediated by representatives of the Kuomintang Headquarters and Seamen's Union, originated as a result of a slash in wages.
Workers, through their spokesman, declared last night that if the present negotiations fail to restore the cuts in their salaries, they would probably have to walk out in order to press for their demands.
The Ningpo-Shaoshing S. N. Company, one of the oldest Chinese-operated steamship firms, is owned by Mr. Yu Ya-ching, well-known and influential local businessman, who is also the head of the San Peh S. N. Company.
Members of Ningpo-Shaoshing crews told pressmen last night that their wages had been slashed considerably during the last year, with decreased business revenue being the reason offered by the company.
During the past six months, however, the surcharges on Yangtse River steamship transport had steadily increased, the workers said, and the company's business had been on the upgrade.
The workers, in demands made to the company officials, asked for a restoration of their pay cuts.
Local shipowners, both foreign and Chinese, yesterday carefully watched the dispute among the Ningpo-Shaoshing workers as the first evidence of maritime labor unrest among Chinese seamen.

《字林西报》，1937年3月11日，星期四

上海可能很快发生
自有船舶劳工冲突
* * * * * * * * * *
宁绍船员躁动不安
* * * * * * * * * *
要求提高工资

昨天，宁波绍宁轮船公司雇用的船员中酝酿着可能导致该公司船只停运的劳资纠纷。
这场由国民党总部和海员工会代表调解的纠纷，起因于工资削减。
工人们通过其发言人昨晚声明，如果目前的谈判未能恢复被削减的工资，他们可能不得不罢工以迫使实现其要求。
宁波绍宁轮船公司是最古老的华人经营轮船公司之一，由当地知名且有影响力的商人虞洽卿先生所有，他也是三北轮船公司的负责人。
宁波绍宁公司的船员成员昨晚告诉新闻记者，去年他们的工资被大幅削减，公司给出的理由是业务收入减少。
然而，工人们说，在过去六个月里，长江轮船运输的附加费稳步增加，公司的业务一直在好转。
工人在向公司官员提出的要求中，要求恢复被削减的工资。
昨天，本地中外船东密切关注宁波绍宁工人的纠纷，将其视为中国海员中海事劳工动荡的第一个迹象。
